scope: Method and accounting review of archived runtime001 only; no experiments or numerical re-extraction. Current executor/runtime002 not bound by this receipt.

strong_baseline.reason: B caches feature extraction by dataset and matrix content; caches primitive predicates by operator/field/exact bound/exact value; shares identical predicates while retaining eight certificate positions; GEN and dataset are common context computations.
strong_baseline.identity_boundary: Producer/contract/environment identities are fixed for this process and checked by the run. Persistent reuse across changed producers or environment needs those identities in persistent keys.
strong_baseline.warm_cache_implication: Finite five-candidate banks let ordinary memoization retain all outcomes after warmup. PPG can remove logical position obligations but does not thereby remove further expensive feature extraction beyond B.
strong_baseline.known_cost_structure: Dominant cold policy cost is actual feature extraction, including support-pair loops. Eight-position counting is not the same as expensive producer work.

accounting.interpretation: Cold means empty controller policy caches within an already imported/prepared process, not a cold process or machine. Report setup+cold policy timing separately from common preparation, shared validation and new formal setup.
accounting.common_costs: Imports, actual GEN, coupling generation and reference preparation are common preparation; fresh validation is shared across corresponding decision streams. Charge or disclose common work for both arms.
accounting.unmeasured: Historical framework/dependency preparation and aggregate human/AI effort are unmeasured, not zero. Input pre-hashing and final export/validation overhead are not all included in policy medians. No complete end-to-end lifecycle-cost claim follows.
accounting.conclusion: No practical superiority shown; reported source/data/decision scope supports a local finite timing comparison only.

finite_domain.reason: Per-context five-source truth tables give a complete finite source domain; explicit state-identity guards check source and target membership. Operations preserve the same context GEN/dataset.
finite_domain.limit: No continuous-coupling domain coverage, raw-feature update closure, physical controller refinement, original MT guarantee or scientific novelty established.
finite_domain.negative_context: Signed negative GEN is retained for boot334 rather than silently filtering it through the original positive-GEN binding wrapper.

required_reporting_limits: The uncached validation oracle recomputes each proposed target independently of both policy caches, but uses the SAME original _local_plan_features and Check implementation. It is not an independent implementation proof of feature extraction.

runtime001 TRACES.json is reference-oracle-generated commit/rollback traces, not actual per-arm trace execution. Root is separately revising this in runtime002; this receipt does not pre-approve that revision.
CONTROLS.json validates low-level frame and numeric admission helpers, not end-to-end execution of both controllers on malformed/protected-write proposals.

NO_OBSERVABLE_REUSE disables hazard use as well as primitive-atom cache reuse, while retaining feature caching and context GEN/dataset. It is a joint diagnostic, not an isolated subalgebra/observable-reuse ablation.
NO_HAZARD still prepares PPG tables and charges their cost before bypassing them; it is an intentionally diagnostic arm, not the optimized standard baseline.
The aggressive prior-PASS control is a deliberately unsafe negative control, not a measured standard production tool or evidence of unique PPG necessity.
All ordered proposals are constructed coupling replacements over measured marginals. They are not a recorded sequence of physical controller repairs.
safe_summary: The finite PPG rule and ordinary memoized B agree in safety and acceptance. PPG eliminates some logical rechecks but is slower on this workload and requires new formal setup. This supports certified feature-model preservation, not algorithmic necessity or speed advantage.
